content.title: Timothée Chalamet Girlfriend: Who is She? — Timothée Chalamet’s Complete Dating History
content.text: Culture From Lily-Rose Depp to (potentially) Kylie Jenner, meet the past and present girlfriends of our favourite leading man. Timothée Chalamet is easily one of the biggest names in Hollywood. The actor, who is currently preparing to lead the upcoming Bob Dylan biopic, A Complete Unknown, has starred in a string of box office hits including Little Women and Interstellar. Apart from his impressive acting ability, it is his natural waves, proven emotional intelligence, and suave persona that have made him quite the heartthrob. Everyone’s obsession with the Dune actor is easy to spot, as evidenced by Chalamet’s many (many) fan accounts. It’s safe to say that the thespian is wanted by many, hence the piqued interest in his romantic affairs. Continue ahead for our favourite leading man's complete dating history. 17-year-old Chalamet was linked to Lourdes Leon, Madonna’s daughter, back in 2013. The two began to date after meeting at LaGuardia High School in the actor's hometown of New York City. From the little we know about their relationship, it appears to have been short-lived. In fact, its very existence remained only speculation for nearly a decade until Leon confirmed the romance in an April 2021 interview. She told Vanity Fair, “I respect him a lot, we were a little item. My first boyfriend.” Chalamet’s relationship with Chanel model Lily-Rose Depp is his longest and most well-known romantic affair to date. The two made it official in October 2018 after working together on Netflix’s The King, after which they were spotted on casual dates around NYC. Gradually seeing less and less of the couple in public, whispers at the time indicated that the two had called it quits. Though, rumors were swiftly squashed following the couple's joint appearance at the Venice Film Festival in 2019—not to mention photos surfacing of the two sharing a kiss whilst boating in Capri. “I went to bed that night thinking that was one of the best days of my life,” Chalamet told GQ. News of the couple’s split came one year later in April 2020, when Chalamet, who was photographed for British Vogue, told the publication that he was single. Why the pair called ended things is anyone’s guess. Just two months after ending his two-year-long relationship with Depp, The Daily Mail released photos of Chalamet canoodling with Mexican actress Eiza González. The two were seen vacationing in Cabo, but alas, a short five months later in October 2022, the couple broke up.Word on the street is that Chalamet is dating cosmetics CEO Kylie Jenner. Although yet to be addressed by either party, their potential romance is worth noting. Rumours began to spiral after Instagram gossip maven @Deuxmoi claimed to have been tipped off by multiple sources confirming their relationship. Following the blind items, the account posted a video of Chalamet and Jenner laughing together at Paris Fashion Week. Given Jenner’s recent split from rapper Travis Scott and Chalamet’s six-month-single status, the possibility of the two dating seems plausible.
